- On e-sign: legal prefers DocuSign with evidence of the signatory's title. For Ariba-only acceptance we need the supplier admin email + supplier ID and a signed delegation (if the signer is not listed as authorized purchaser).
- Order Form: Ops needs a required PO field mapping: PO number (string), PO date, PO line-level unitOfMeasure and price. If MedCore splits PO lines, our ingestion must preserve line ids to avoid double-billing — add clause to Order Form that PO line_id must be unique per line.
- SLA / PO ack: propose adding an operational clause requiring PO acknowledgement within 48 hours for onboarding customers — reduces chargeback noise.

Markus: looping you for legal on one redline we flagged re: limitation of liability referencing the Order Form. I pulled notes into redline_notes_for_ops.txt attached for ops-specific asks.

Hannah — thanks for the clear note and the redlines. A few items from procurement/legal on our side:

- E-sign: MedCore accepts DocuSign for agreements > $0 provided the signer is the person listed in our Ariba supplier admin contact. If the person signing is different, we need an authorization letter on company letterhead (scanned PDF) that shows delegated signatory authority. We use Ariba identity proofing for new suppliers: acceptable evidence is (1) Articles of Incorporation, (2) W-9/Tax ID verification, and (3) a photo ID for the supplier admin.
- Technical integration: we prefer receiving PO via Ariba; however, for initial ramp we can accept SFTP-delivered PO XMLs. I'll attach our PO XML sample and the Ariba field spec.
- PO format: our POs use a 3-letter prefix (MED) + 7-digit number, PO line splitting is supported but we will include unique line_item_id per line. Remit-to is the billingAddress object in the PO xml.

I've attached vendor_evidence_form.pdf and a sample PO XML (see attached). We can also schedule a 30-min intake with our supplier enablement team to walk fields — Sabrina (cc) is our supply enablement lead and will coordinate.

Pls confirm whether DocuSign + supplier admin info satisfies you and we can proceed to activate the supplier record in Ariba.

Best,
Jill Torres
Procurement Lead | MedCore Health
jill.torres@medcore.com | +1 (617) 555-0142

Hi all — quick legal read-through after seeing Jill's notes. A few short points: 

- Authorization: DocuSign + supplier admin evidence (Articles + W-9) is acceptable. Please attach the supplier admin email as part of the DocuSign envelope metadata or include it in the Ariba supplier profile. That ties the signature to an identity and keeps our audit trail clean.
- Order Form redline: I recommend a small Order Form clause that 1) binds the Order Form to the MSA (we already have footnote language) and 2) requires purchase orders to reference the Order Form ID. I'll attach a cleaned MSA with my inline comments (msa_clean_with_markus_comments.pdf).
- Liability carveout: one redline in the MSA re: limitation of liability references "each Order" — I'd like to tie the measurement of damages to the specific Order Form (not any hypothetical future Order). This is a quick amendment and low risk, but important for renewals.

Next steps I propose:
- Jordan: coordinate field mapping and upload the sample PO XML into OPS-4721 (Karthik will own).
- Hannah: confirm DocuSign envelope will include supplier admin email and loop Sabrina to schedule the intake call.
- Ops: once supplier evidence is received (vendor_evidence_form.pdf), we can proceed to create the Ariba supplier record and attach the signed Order Form.

I'll be available for a 20-min legal/ops sync tomorrow morning if helpful.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
